evidence.observation: Reboiler reads ~417-420 °C, physically implausible and far off the ~84 °C of the adjacent stage T702; flat, slowly drifting signal suggests a failed/miscalibrated thermocouple
Coherent, smooth column profile 84 °C down to ~68 °C with gradual top-end cooling; consistent operation
Reflux ~0.22-0.43 L/h, distillate ~0.31-0.64 L/h, ratio jumping between ~2.7 and ~3.9 — noisy but no trend break

args.missing_evidence: An independent reboiler temperature reading (or calibration check of T701) and a distillate composition/GC measurement to judge separation.
